author: _DipperPines
body:
Hey Guys! Today I have my newest map to be displayed! It is called Ancient. It uses the 1.8 ocean monument blocks. And before you say Avicus is not 1.8, just know that the DTM01 rotation IS 1.8 so that is where it will go. Anyway, this map has hidden diamonds, a lot pvp space, and what I think is a lot of block variation and detail. Below are links to a video and some pictures. The pictures are not up to date so I would recommend the video.  We really hope you like it!

Note: This is NOt the official release, hence no download and YML.

Video:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Me8RWSWXeJA
Pictures:
https://sites.google.com/site/avicusmaps/ancient---1-8 (DEFINITELY not up to date) WATCH THE VIDEO!

replies.author: Arigenn
replies.body:
Interesting looking map.

A possibility to enhance the quality of the gameplay, is to take some of those central islands, and spread them out a bit more. When doing this, you should also increase the size of each island, and maybe include some little special objective or item that would make people want to travel to these islands. I also find that spawn islands are a bit blocky and squarish when it comes to the shape of the actual island. More circular type islands work best when it comes to aesthetics. Another thing to think about it maybe editing the size of your monument islands, as sometimes small islands are hard on defenders. The monuments should also maybe be moved a bit closer to center, so matches don't get too stalematey.

Other than that, your map looks pretty cool! I love the theme, and if you make just a few revisions based on those points the map should be just fine.

replies.author: Fouled
replies.body:
Some things I would fix:

1. Make the islands more circular or have a distinguished shape. Currently, the edges are way too blocky and doesn't look too aesthetically pleasing. Most of the center islands look fine, I would mostly worry about the spawn island.

2. Remove the guardian spawner. There's not really a use for a spawner, it wouldn't work too well with that size of a map. This can also decrease the quality of gameplay in a way if you think about it.

3. Make the side monument islands somewhat larger. At the moment, the size of it is too small and does not offer much space to mine the monument/defend/have multiple players standing at that location.

Also, if you can, it would be good to have updated pictures of your map. This way, people can view your map in more detail without having to rewatch/skip through the video.

Anyways, nice job on the map so far & good luck with the edits! :)
